method: AST enumeration of every executable function declaration, function expression, arrow, method, constructor and accessor in first-party source/test/script/config files. Callbacks inherit the nearest mapped owning symbol unless a specific name mapping applies. Associations express use-case responsibility, not executed test coverage. Types without bodies belong to their file workflow.
